delay.v1/course.instructions: What should happen next with the delayed work described here?

criteria.keep_going: Let the work carry on unchanged and look again later: it is worth finishing and it is still moving, or too little is known to change anything.
criteria.switch_model: Make the same request again on a different model: the delay is the model's own, and another would answer the same request.
criteria.change_approach: Let the work carry on, but tell it what is delayed so it may plan differently: it is worth finishing and it is not moving the way it is going.
criteria.narrow_scope: Let the work carry on against a smaller objective: the whole of it is not worth what it would cost, and a part of it is.
criteria.stop_and_report: Stop the work and report where it got to: it is not worth finishing, or it is stuck on something that will not resolve.

delay.v1/progressing.instructions: Is the delayed work described here still moving toward the result it was started for?

criteria.true: The work is still moving: the signals described show it doing something that leads toward its result, even where that is slow.
criteria.false: The work is not moving: the signals described show it stalled, repeating itself, or waiting on something that is not coming.

delay.v1/worth_it.instructions: Given what it has already cost and what it was for, is the delayed work described here still worth finishing?

criteria.true: Finishing the delayed work is still worth what it will cost: the result it was started for still matters, and no cheaper way to that result is described here.
criteria.false: Finishing the delayed work is no longer worth what it will cost: the result it was started for has stopped mattering, or what it has spent is already out of proportion to it.
